question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘Those Pricey Thakur Girls’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anuja Chauhan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book 'Those Pricey Thakur Girls' is authored by **Anuja Chauhan**.
 
• Anuja Chauhan is an Indian author known for her work in contemporary fiction.
 
• Her other notable works include 'The Zoya Factor', 'Battle for Bittora', and 'The House That BJ Built'.
 
• 'Those Pricey Thakur Girls' is a novel that revolves around the lives of five sisters and their experiences in Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Anuja Chauhan's writing style is often described as witty, engaging, and filled with humor.
 
• She has a background in advertising and has worked on several popular campaigns before turning to writing full-time.
 
• 'Those Pricey Thakur Girls' was adapted into a television series titled 'Dilli Wali Thakur Gurls'.
 
• Her works often reflect the contemporary urban Indian setting and resonate with a broad audience.
